1. What information do we collect and why?

1.1 The term “Personal Data” as used in this privacy notice means any information relating to you from which you can be identified, such as your name, contact details, bank account details etc. Personal Data does not include data from which you can no longer be identified such as anonymized aggregate data.

1.2 We may collect different types of Personal Data about you which we have grouped together as follows: Identity Data, Contact Data, Employment Data, Financial Data, Transaction Data, Technical Data, Usage Data and Marketing and Communications Data.

1.3 In order to play for real money at Xlotbet we need your name, e-mail address, mailing address, credit card number and expiration date. This information allows us to process all of your credit requests fast and accurately.

1.4 When you enter a competition or promotion we may ask you for your e-mail address, mailing address and name so that we can notify the winners. You can unsubscribe from any mail you do not wish to receive from us.

1.5 When you participate in a customer survey we may ask for your name, e-mail address and other personal information. We do this to ensure that we construct and modify our Services according to the wishes of our players.

1.6 We monitor player traffic patterns and site usage to help us develop and enhance the design of our gaming web sites.

1.7 We may use your IP address to help diagnose problems with our server, and to administer our Web site. Your IP address is used to gather broad demographic information.

2. Advertising System

2.1 Our advertising system logs IP addresses to supply more accurate advertising features, such as language specific banners. It does not log other personal information.

3. Account Creation Information

3.1 The account information supplied during the account creation process is kept strictly confidential for our own purpose. We do not share this information outside of our organization.

3.2 This information includes customer e-mail addresses and other personal information supplied upon registration. If you supply us with your personal details, the information will only be used for its intended use, such as allowing us to send you cash-out checks and other information which you request.

3.3 E-mail Addresses are not shared with any other organization for commercial or non-commercial purposes. E-mail addresses will only be used to provide our customers with information regarding new software updates, promotional material, and miscellaneous operations, such as deposits and withdrawals.

3.4 We collect e-mail addresses of those who communicate with us via e-mail.

4. Winnings

4.1 Your winnings and cash-outs are kept strictly confidential, and winnings information is stored in secure operating environments. Xlotbet keeps your winnings information private and does not provide this information to any third party unless such information is required to be disclosed by law, regulation or any governmental or competent regulatory authority.

5. How Do We Collect Your Personal Data?

5.1 We use different methods to collect Personal Data from and about you including through:

5.1.1 Direct interactions. You may give us your Identity and Contact Data by filling in forms or by corresponding with us by post, phone, email or otherwise.

5.1.2 Automated technologies or interactions. As you interact with our website and application, we may automatically collect technical data about your equipment, browsing actions and patterns. This may be collected through the use of cookies.

5.1.3 Third parties or publicly available sources. We may receive Personal Data about you from various third parties and public sources such as:

5.1.3.1 Technical data from analytics providers; advertising networks; or search information providers;

5.1.3.2 Contact, financial and transaction data from providers of technical, payment and delivery services.

5.1.3.3 Identity, contact, technical and marketing and communications data from publicly available sources.

5.1.3.4 Where you use third-party social networking sites, the third-party social networking site controls the information it collects from you.

6. International Transfers

6.1 We may have to transfer your Personal Data internationally in order to render services to you. When we do we will always ensure that there is a legal basis and a relevant safeguard method for such data transfer so that your Personal Data is treated in a manner that is consistent with applicable laws and regulations on data protection.

7. Your Rights in Relation To Your Personal Data

7.1 You have rights you can exercise under certain circumstances in relation to your Personal Data that we hold, such as:

7.1.1 Request access to your Personal Data.

7.1.2 Request correction of your Personal Data.

7.1.3 Request erasure of your Personal Data.

7.1.4 Object to processing of your Personal Data.

7.1.5 Request restriction of processing your Personal Data.

7.1.6 Request transfer of your Personal Data.

7.1.7 Right to withdraw consent.

7.1.8 Request certain information regarding our disclosure of Personal Data to third parties for their direct marketing purposes.

7.1.9 You may have additional rights applicable to you under local law. If you wish to exercise any of the rights set out above, please contact us by email.

8. Changes to this Privacy Notice

8.1 We reserve the right to update this privacy notice at any time, and we will make an updated copy of such privacy notice available on our website.

8.2 The last revision date of revision will be updated so that you will always be able to understand what data we collect, how we use your data, and under what circumstances we may share your data with others.

9. Responsible Gambling

9.1 Gambling can be a fun and exciting activity, but it also comes with serious risks. Gambling can lead to addiction, financial problems, mental health issues, and legal troubles. Gambling can also affect your relationships, work, and well-being.

9.2 If you choose to gamble, please do so responsibly and within your means. Set a limit on how much time and money you can afford to spend on gambling, and stick to it. Never gamble with money that you need for essential expenses, such as rent, food, or bills. Never borrow money or use credit cards to gamble. Never gamble under the influence of alcohol or drugs. Never gamble when you are feeling depressed, stressed, or angry.

9.3 Gambling is not a way to solve your problems or make money. It is a form of entertainment that has a high chance of losing. The odds are always in favor of the house, not the player. The longer you gamble, the more likely you are to lose. Gambling can also be influenced by cognitive biases, such as the gambler’s fallacy, the illusion of control, and the sunk cost fallacy.

9.4 You acknowledge that gambling involves risk and that you may lose money. You agree that you will only gamble with money you can afford to lose and will not gamble beyond your means. You agree that you will not gamble under the influence of alcohol, drugs, or any other substance that may impair your judgment. You agree that you will not bet if you suffer from any mental or physical condition affecting your ability to make rational decisions. You agree that you will seek professional help if you have a gambling problem or suspect that you may have one.

9.5 Remember, gambling is not worth risking your health, happiness, or future. Please gamble responsibly and enjoy the game.

9.6 It’s never too late to realize you’re struggling with a gambling addiction. We appreciates and cherishes each one of their clients, and they never try to persuade them to have difficulties.

9.7 Check out the suggestions below for reducing the dangers of gambling addiction:

9.7.1 Don’t attempt to win back losses over and over again;

9.7.2 Never consider gambling to be your sole source of income;

9.7.3 Set a limit for the amount of money you wish to wager or spend at online gambling;

9.7.4 Do not begin gambling if you are under the influence of drugs or alcohol;

9.7.5 Be mindful of the dangers and only bet with money you don’t mind losing.
